answer: One look at the firing log settles what a hundred assurances cannot. Renewal charges 149 POA every epoch, so the farm's 315 masks bleed 46935 POA again next epoch. Give the epoch a backbone: Copyist writ sheet proof lettered across the chancery office, proved by each writ sheet is a stroke count weighed beside the makers mark, checked by strangers. The proof is not the applicant's word; it is a record held by hands that owe the applicant nothing. Behind every ember there is a workshop, behind every quartz a ledger, behind every orchard a calendar, and the farm has visited none of the three.
